texts.facts: 2. The writ petition has been filed for a mandamus forbearing the respondent No.3 and his subordinates and men from interfering with the petitioner's business by consideration his representation dated 06.06.2024. 3. The petitioner seeks a direction forbearing the third respondent Food Safety Officer from exercising his statutory duties. According to the petitioner, at the instruction of the 4th respondent, the third respondent is interfering with his business.
